method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: US equity funds post biggest weekly outflow since March ahead of Nvidia earnings, Fed event
Equities.reason: Large weekly fund outflows ahead of Nvidia earnings and a Fed event point to tangible, near-term risk-off flows that can pressure broad equities.

Equities.title: NVIDIA stock remains a buy after blockbuster earnings
Equities.reason: Blockbuster Nvidia results reinforce the AI-led market leadership narrative and are a major positive driver for US equities, especially tech.

Equities.title: Marc Benioff is getting his mojo back as Salesforce's AI strength quiets skeptics
Equities.summary: Salesforce's stock had its second-best day on record following earnings, as Wall Street shows renewed confidence in CEO Marc Benioff's AI story.
Equities.reason: Renewed confidence in Salesforce's AI story supports the broader enterprise-AI narrative and helps sustain tech/AI leadership in equities.

Equities.title: Stock traders warm up to Warsh as volatility index touches year-to-date low
Equities.summary: The Cboe Volatility Index (VIX), which measures the price of 30-day options on the S&P 500 Index, fell to as low as 14.1.
Equities.reason: VIX at YTD low signals subdued volatility and risk-on positioning, a supportive backdrop for equities sentiment (offsetting some macro worries).

Equities.title: U.S. stocks mostly lower in final hour after Warsh fuels rate-hike expectations
Equities.reason: Comments from the Fed chair that increase rate-hike expectations weigh on stocks and raise monetary policy uncertainty for markets.

Equities.title: US Job Growth Marked Down in Preliminary Benchmark Estimate
Equities.reason: A downward revision to job growth reduces near-term upside pressure on inflation and can modestly ease the path for policy, a modest positive for equities.

Equities.title: Marvell shares tumble 6% as outlook underwhelms despite 37% revenue growth
Equities.summary: Marvell Technology shares fell Friday despite a second-quarter revenue beat, as its fiscal 2028 outlook failed to meet investors' expectations.
Equities.reason: Company-specific weak guidance in a key chip supplier highlights investor sensitivity within semiconductors; negative for the stock and a small cautionary signal for the sector.

Rates.title: Fed Chairman Warsh expresses concern about inflation, advocates for 'quieter' central bank
Rates.summary: He used the speech to outline his philosophy on policymaking while carefully sidestepping any signals
Rates.reason: Warsh's Jackson Hole rhetoric reiterating inflation focus increases rate-hike risk and drove higher Treasury yields; material for rates markets (bond selloff / higher-for-longer pricing).

Rates.title: 2-year Treasury yield jumps as Warsh says Fed may 'have work to do'
Rates.summary: Investors assessed Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish message in his keynote address at Jackson Hole.
Rates.reason: Direct market reaction: short-end yields (2y) jumped on hawkish Fed messaging, implying tighter policy expectations and negative bond-price implications.

Rates.title: Warsh Is Driving Treasuries Market, Whether He Wants to or Not
Rates.reason: Analysis that Warsh's comments are moving Treasury pricing — reinforces dominant narrative of Fed-driven repricing toward higher yields / higher-for-longer policy.

Rates.title: VIEW Rate-hike expectations rise on Warsh speech at Jackson Hole
Rates.reason: Reuters view piece noting market re-pricing toward higher hike odds after Warsh — relevant for rates as it signals increased probability of policy tightening and upward pressure on yields.

Rates.title: Japan: Tokyo CPI data supports BoJ hawkish stance – Societe Generale
Rates.summary: Societe Generale’s Reo Sakida and Jin Kenzaki note that August Tokyo CPI was broadly in line with expectations, with renewed energy subsidies weighing on inflation and likely to drag on CPI through October.
Rates.reason: Tokyo CPI supporting a hawkish BoJ stance points to tighter JGBs expectations; smaller but relevant regional rates tightening signal (upward pressure on yields).

Rates.title: South Korean Won: BoK front-loading hikes as KRW consolidates – Commerzbank
Rates.summary: Commerzbank’s Charlie Lay reports the Bank of Korea has delivered back-to-back 25bp hikes to 3.0%, front-loading tightening as growth and core inflation forecasts rise. The bank signals one more hike over six months but may pause to assess effects.
Rates.reason: BoK's front-loaded hikes indicate regional policy tightening and higher local yields; relevant to EM/Asia rates and broader global rate-tightening backdrop.

Rates.title: Philippine Peso: BSP tightening bias on inflation risks – DBS
Rates.summary: DBS Group Research economists Radhika Rao and Chua Han Teng note that Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) raised its policy rate by 25 bps to 5.0% to anchor inflation expectations and support the Peso.
Rates.reason: BSP tightening and a policy-rate hike directly raise local rates and reflect EM tightening bias; modest relevance for global rates narrative.

Rates.title: Fed’s Goolsbee says inflation is the main issue right now
Rates.summary: Chicago Federal Reserve (Fed) President Austan Goolsbee commented in a CNBC interview at the Jackson Hole Symposium on Friday that he agreed with Fed Chair Kevin Warsh about the details of the economy, adding that “inflation is the Fed’s main issue right now.”
Rates.reason: Goolsbee echoing Warsh reinforces Fed hawkish consensus, increasing likelihood of persistent rate pressure and negative bond-price implications.

FX.title: US Dollar Index rallies as Warsh puts September rate hike back on the table
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY) rallies on Friday, gaining 0.36% to trade around 99.50 at the time of writing, as Federal Reserve (Fed) Chair Kevin Warsh’s hawkish remarks at the Jackson Hole Symposium prompt investors to sharply reassess the outlook for US interest
FX.reason: Direct USD/DXY move driven by a hawkish Fed signal (Warsh). USD strength is the dominant FX narrative today and pressures major USD crosses.

FX.title: British Pound tumbles as Warsh revives Fed hike bets
FX.summary: The Pound Sterling (GBP) tumbles versus the US Dollar (USD) on Friday as Federal Reserve (Fed) Chair Kevin Warsh put inflation as the priority at the Fed, increasing the likelihood of an interest rate hike next month. The GBP/USD trades at 1.3538, down 0.40%.
FX.reason: GBPUSD falls on renewed Fed hike risk — representative single-currency reaction to USD strength; clear FX-native move with medium relevance.

FX.title: Euro slides below 1.1600 as Warsh brings Fed rate hike back into play
FX.summary: EUR/USD falls sharply toward 1.1595 on Friday at the time of writing, losing 0.48% on the day, as the US Dollar (USD) rallies following Federal Reserve (Fed) Chair Kevin Warsh’s speech at the Jackson Hole Symposium.
FX.reason: EURUSD weakening directly tied to USD re-pricing after Warsh — high relevance for USD-centric FX flows and European crosses.

FX.title: Australian Dollar retreats from highs as Warsh’s hawkish message lifts US Dollar
FX.summary: AUD/USD retreats 0.30% on Friday to trade around 0.7170 at the time of writing, correcting after reaching its highest level since mid-May at 0.7206 earlier in the day.
FX.reason: AUDUSD gives back gains as USD strength from hawkish Fed comments reverses risk-sensitive FX moves; relevant as part of broad USD-led retracement.

FX.title: Mexican Peso tumbles as Warsh embarks on inflation fight
FX.summary: The Mexican Peso (MXN) depreciates against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, down by over 0.42% on hawkish remarks by Federal Reserve (Fed) Chair Kevin Warsh at the Jackson Hole Symposium. This prompted investors to price in a potential rate hike in 2026, a tailw
FX.reason: MXN weakness versus USD after Fed-hawk repricing — direct USD-centric FX move relevant for EMFX flows and carry dynamics.

FX.title: The Japanese Yen gives up the big figure intervention won back
FX.summary: Japan delivered the inflation and labour data the Bank of Japan needs to move next month and the Japanese Yen is weaker for a fifth consecutive session.
FX.reason: JPY weakness is persistent and linked to domestic data and BOJ timing — contributes to USD/JPY upside and is a key FX market stress point given recent intervention history.

FX.title: Japan Spent Record $98.7 Billion to Prop Up Yen in Joint Move With U.S.
FX.reason: Large, joint intervention to support JPY is a major FX event: underscores severe JPY weakness and potential for volatility and policy coordination — high importance for USD/JPY and global FX flows.

FX.title: Bessent attacks Warren over yen intervention query, offers ‘Foreign Exchange for Dummies’ lesson
FX.summary: Treasury has not disclosed how much yen it bought, the execution rate or the current value of the position, despite Warren’s requests for details.
FX.reason: Discussion about Treasury transparency around yen intervention reinforces JPY/USD policy interplay; relevant but lower signal than direct price/intervention totals.

FX.title: South Korean Won: BoK tightening supports KRW against US Dollar – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Charlie Lay reports that the Bank of Korea (BoK) delivered a second consecutive 25 bp hike to 3.0% and kept a tightening bias, supporting KRW after its sharp appreciation since June.
FX.reason: BoK rate hikes and tightening bias are a direct domestic driver supporting KRW vs USD — important local-rate differential FX story.

FX.title: South Korean Won: Strong exports support KRW and KOSPI – DBS
FX.summary: DBS Group strategists Taimur Baig and Nathan Chow expect South Korea’s August exports to stay strong near 60% year-on-year, underpinning the outlook for the KOSPI and Korean Won (KRW) even as growth moderates from June’s peak.
FX.reason: Fundamental export strength provides additional support to KRW beyond BoK policy; relevant for KRW positioning but lower immediate FX market impact than rate moves.

FX.title: The Canadian Dollar falls on the best quarter since 2023
FX.summary: Canada produced the strongest growth figure of the cycle and the Canadian Dollar (CAD) is weaker for it.
FX.reason: Notable CAD/USD reaction where stronger domestic growth coincides with CAD weakness — FX-native but idiosyncratic; moderate relevance to cross flows.

FX.title: Breaking: Nonfarm Payrolls benchmark revision to lower US employment by 79,000 through March 2026
FX.summary: According to the preliminary estimate of the Current Employment Statistics (CES) national benchmark revision, Nonfarm employment for March 2026 was -79,000 (-0.1%), the US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reported on Friday.
FX.reason: A material downward revision to US payrolls is USD-negative (weakens US growth/labour story), which can soften USD and support non‑USD currencies — meaningful macro datapoint for FX positioning.

Commodities.title: Gold tumbles as Warsh sparks rally on the US Dollar
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) prices extend losses to over 2.50% on Friday as market participants digest hawkish comments from Federal Reserve (Fed) Chair Kevin Warsh at Jackson Hole. Rising US Treasury yields and overall US Dollar strength are the two drivers of the sudden
Commodities.reason: Hawkish Fed comments and a stronger USD/ rising US yields are a clear negative for gold (classic rates/USD-driven compression). Large intraday move (~2.5%) makes this an important macro catalyst for the gold market.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: False breakout and hawkish Fed sink XAG
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) price made a U-turn after reaching a two-month high of $71.12 on Friday, then dove below the $69.00 figure as Federal Reserve (Fed) Chair Kevin Warsh leaned hawkish in his Jackson Hole speech, pushing US Treasury yields higher.
Commodities.reason: Silver reacted similarly to gold as higher US yields and a stronger USD undercut precious metals; technical false breakout reduces short-term bullish credibility (moderate relevance given silver's dual industrial/precious demand).

Commodities.title: Corn and wheat prices jump to highest prices in more than three years
Commodities.reason: Large multi-year highs for core grains signal tightening supply/demand in key agricultural markets — significant for the grains complex and for inflation/food-price risk transmission to broader commodity markets.

Commodities.title: Gulf Oil Tankers Near $650,000 a Day as Iran War Disrupts Flows
Commodities.reason: Severe tanker-rate spike driven by Middle East conflict materially raises oil transport costs and signals large disruptions to seaborne crude flows — a high-impact supply shock that is strongly bullish for oil prices.

Commodities.title: U.S. Navy blockade slashes Iran oil exports as Trump administration shifts to economic warfare
Commodities.summary: The U.S. has shifted to a campaign of economic warfare, after a dozen waves of airstrikes in July failed to force Tehran to abandon its claim to Hormuz.
Commodities.reason: An enforced cut in Iran's seaborne exports is a direct supply-side shock to crude markets; military/economic measures materially tighten near-term oil availability and increase risk premia.

Commodities.title: Longer wells boost Permian crude oil and natural gas production
Commodities.summary: Well operators in the Permian region of western Texas and eastern New Mexico are getting more oil and gas out of the ground by drilling longer, horizontal wells and increasingly incorporating so-called super-lateral wells that exceed 15,000 feet.
Commodities.reason: Productivity gains in the Permian raise structural US crude and gas supply; positive for output growth and a modest tailwind to lower prices over time (incremental, not a sudden shock).

Commodities.title: Oil Giant Chevron Is Said to Be in Talks to Expand in Venezuela
Commodities.reason: Reports that majors may expand Venezuelan production suggest potential easing of supply constraints if deals proceed; bearish for oil but contingent on political/legal implementation (medium relevance).

Commodities.title: Trump says US to take control of 65bn barrels of Venezuelan oil
Commodities.summary: The president says the countries’ joint venture will lower petrol prices for Americans
Commodities.reason: A high-profile political announcement to control Venezuelan reserves implies potential major incremental supply to the U.S. market — materially bearish if credible, though implementation and global spillovers are uncertain.

Commodities.title: Dangote refinery drives increase in petroleum shipments from Nigeria
Commodities.summary: Seaborne petroleum product exports from Nigeria have grown seven-fold since 2023, playing an increasing role in the international market for petroleum products at a time when supplies from other areas have been constrained.
Commodities.reason: New refinery-driven export capacity increases global refined product supply and eases regional tightness — modestly bearish for product cracks and refined-product-driven crude demand.

Commodities.title: Eight petroleum liquids pipeline projects have been completed since the start of 2025
Commodities.summary: In the 2026 release of our Liquids Pipeline Projects Database, we tracked the completion of 8 liquid fuels pipeline projects since the start of 2025, and an additional 14 new projects have been announced.
Commodities.reason: Completed pipeline projects reduce transport bottlenecks and can boost effective supply availability — a modest structural bearish factor for regional crude/product spreads.

Commodities.title: Natural Gas: Hormuz risks and Qatari LNG disruption – BNY
Commodities.summary: Geoff Yu at BNY highlights that Middle East tensions and constrained traffic through the Strait of Hormuz are keeping key energy supply routes at risk.
Commodities.reason: Heightened geopolitical risk around Hormuz and potential Qatari LNG disruption raise tail risk for global gas flows and tighten near-term LNG fundamentals — bullish for natural gas/LNG prices.

Crypto.title: Solana vote to double disinflation passes by a hair in dramatic finish
Crypto.reason: Protocol-level supply reduction (faster disinflation) is a direct positive for SOL token economics and reduces long-term sell pressure — token-specific but market-relevant given Solana's market-cap and narrative around on-chain upgrades.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin hits highest level in 3 months before pulling back as altcoins consolidate
Crypto.reason: BTC momentum and higher price highs support risk appetite and ETF/liquidity narratives; market-wide relevance but still routine price action, so moderate positive signal for crypto risk assets.

Crypto.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slides below $78,000 as markets digest Warsh's hawkish remarks
Crypto.reason: Macro monetary hawkishness (Fed/Warsh commentary) hits risk assets and crypto particularly strongly given rate sensitivity and recent price leverage — a significant negative for short-term crypto sentiment and flows.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin is trading at a premium on Coinbase after a long time. Here's what it means
Crypto.reason: Exchange-level premium indicates localized demand and tighter spot/ETF spreads, signalling genuine buying pressure — supportive for BTC price and ETF/liquidity narratives.

Crypto.title: Visa doubles down on South Korea with Upbit operator Dunamu on stablecoin payments
Crypto.reason: Large payments-network partnership expanding regulated stablecoin rails is a strong adoption/utility signal for crypto payments and institutional onramps — material positive for crypto infrastructure and flows.

Crypto.title: Kraken users briefly locked out after a flood of sanctioned crypto transactions
Crypto.reason: Operational disruption tied to sanctioned transactions highlights ongoing sanctions/compliance risk for exchanges and can impair liquidity and user trust — negative for exchange stability and onshore flows.

Crypto.title: Kalshi takes legal blow in court ruling confirming state powers over prediction markets
Crypto.reason: Court ruling affirming state regulatory powers is a negative legal precedent for prediction-market platforms and could curb product innovation and institutional participation in that niche.

Crypto.title: Ripple is preparing XRP Ledger for quantum computers before ‘Q-Day’ arrives
Crypto.reason: Proactive cryptographic hardening against quantum risk is technically positive for long-term ledger security and counterparty confidence, but low immediate market impact.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin wallets untouched for 10 years moved $40 million. Most avoided exchanges
Crypto.reason: Old-wallet activity moving coins but largely avoiding exchanges can be interpreted as non-selling interest from long-term holders — a small supportive signal for supply-side dynamics, low relevance vs. market cap.
